Cost Per Dose: 100eb (Premium)

Glitter is a highly addictive psychedelic drug and recent arrival on Night City's streets. The new substance quickly drew Night City's full attention. First, it's truly strong stuff, even for the booster-and-braindance glutted residents of Night City. Second, glitter is illegal, immediately giving it the irresistible aura of "forbidden fruit." Finally: glitter kills. One off-dose or weak nervous system and glitter will have those neurons firing white-hot (hence the name, perhaps). Death is inevitable.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 10 minutes.
  • User takes 1d6 Humanity Loss upon taking a dose, which is returned if the user isn’t affected by Glitter’s Secondary Effect.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, once per Round the user may choose to spend an Action or Move Action to fully embrace Glitter’s intense hallucinations and glimpse through reality. When done, the user receives guidance or advice directly from the GM about a character, plot element, or other relevant entity in the current scene (e.g., “That wall might have a hidden door,” or “The VIP might be lying about who they work for,” or “That mook looks like the weakest among their group”, etc). Note, NPCs can use this same perk against the PCs at GM discretion.

NOTE to GMs: While you can provide harmful guidance or advice, it’s good practice to avoid doing so to a player too often, as that wouldn’t be very fair or fun for anyone. Though, feel free to have NPCs with Glitter randomly change allegiances or act in unusual ways, especially if the players use Glitter against them.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV19) ⋘

  • If the user wasn’t addicted to Glitter, they are now. While addicted, unless the user is currently experiencing the Primary Effect of Glitter, their INT and TECH are reduced by 2 (Minimum 1), and their Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "Glitter Addiction" effect.
  • When an addicted character doses, use "Glitter Addicted Primary" instead of the normal primary effect; it cancels the withdrawal penalties for the duration.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
